text:
Alex: Heads up — our fiddle-leaf on 4F near the coffee station is officially saved! :tada:
Mika: Wait what happened?
Alex: Someone left it in the bathroom sink overnight... nearly drowned. I rescued it, repotted into fresh soil, and it's airing out now. :sweat_smile:
Jamal: OMG bless you, Alex. The fiddle is sacred.
Tara: Legend. Should we make a tiny 'thank you' sign for the plant? :heart:
Sarah: Sending a "Plant CPR" badge to Alex. @People-Ops can we get a sticker? :laughing:
People-Ops: Love this. We'll print a 'Plant Guardian' sticker and a low-key certificate on Monday. :sparkles:
Facilities-Bot: Temperature/humidity logs show a spike near 4F at 21:12 last night. Marked as anomalous. :eyes:
Mika: @Facilities can we put a laminated "do not rinse plants" note by that sink? Pretty please.
Facilities: Good call — we'll put up signage and move the spare watering can to the janitor closet.
Jamal: Also, who wants to volunteer for weekend plant duty? I can cover Saturdays.
Alex: I'll add a micro-rotation in the rotations doc and tag people. Huge thanks to everyone for the quick moral support (and immediate rescue). :seedling: :raised_hands:
Tara: Small rescue, big vibes. Coffee + donut for Alex on me this afternoon. :doughnut: :coffee:
